_comment: Owned by the software team. Defines every calibratable parameter, its unit and its allowed range. A calibration file may only choose values inside these limits; changing a limit is a software change and goes through code review.

dt.description: Task period. Fixed by the software schedule, not tunable.

derate_start.description: Winding temperature where thermal derating begins.

derate_end.description: Winding temperature where derating reaches its minimum.

temp_critical.description: Confirmed temperature above this forces SAFE mode.

limit_slew_down.description: Max rate the torque limit may fall.

limit_slew_up.description: Max rate the torque limit may recover.

safe_ramp.description: Torque ramp-down rate in SAFE mode.

temp_jump.description: Max plausible step between consecutive readings.

speed_jump.description: Max plausible step between consecutive readings.

fault_debounce_ticks.description: Consecutive ticks needed to confirm a fault.

rules.why: The integrator may never hold more torque than the motor can deliver.
The derating curve must have a positive temperature span.
The hysteresis exit point must be a plausible temperature.
SAFE must trigger only after derating has reached its minimum.
A critical temperature must still count as a plausible reading.
The limit must fall faster than it recovers (protect first).
